runs.text: A Two-Column Study of Reading Order
Abstract

- Born-digital documents keep their text as real characters, so a converter can read the exact font, size and colour of every word. The hard part is recovering structure: which lines form a paragraph, where a heading starts, and in which order the columns are read.
